## Error Handler Workflow

1. Import and activate this workflow FIRST.
2. Copy its Workflow ID (visible in the URL bar once saved).
3. Open 'AI Invoice Processing Automation' > Settings > Error Workflow, and select this workflow.

Any node failure in the main workflow will trigger this automatically via the built-in Error Trigger node below.
